content.json:
## ALDC quality metrics

One row per TDD phase, emitted by the `bc-dev` plugin's `SubagentStop` hook.

**Read the independence-ratio first.** Implementer and reviewer draw on the same BCQuality corpus, so the review can quietly stop being a measurement and become a consistency check — this is the only number that shows it happening. Below 0.15 the anti-correlation valve is weakening; at zero the review has stopped measuring.

_BCQuality is a remedial corpus, not a completeness standard: green means no known rule was violated, not that the code is correct._

content.query:
let src = customEvents
| where name == 'AldcPhase'
| where '*' in ({Project}) or tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({Project});
let rev = src | where tostring(customDimensions.agent) == 'al-review-subagent';
let agg = rev
| summarize agentF = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.agentFindings)),
            totalF = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.totalFindings)),
            prescribed = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.prescribed)),
            deviated = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.deviated)),
            undeclared = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.undeclared)),
            cited = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.cited)),
            phases = count();
agg
| project
    ['independence-ratio'] = iff(totalF > 0, round(agentF / totalF, 3), todouble(null)),
    ['deviation rate']     = iff(prescribed > 0, round(deviated / prescribed, 3), todouble(null)),
    ['undeclared deviations'] = undeclared,
    ['cited vs prescribed'] = iff(prescribed > 0, round(cited / prescribed, 3), todouble(null)),
    ['reviews'] = todouble(phases)

customEvents
| where name == 'AldcPhase' and tostring(customDimensions.agent) == 'al-review-subagent'
| where '*' in ({Project}) or tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({Project})
| summarize agentF = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.agentFindings)),
            totalF = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.totalFindings))
          by bin(timestamp, 7d)
| extend ['independence-ratio'] = iff(totalF > 0, agentF / totalF, todouble(null))
| extend ['floor (0.15)'] = 0.15
| project timestamp, ['independence-ratio'], ['floor (0.15)']
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Independence-ratio, weekly — the anti-correlation signal

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'AldcPhase'
| where '*' in ({Project}) or tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({Project})
| where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.deviationsDeclared))
| extend paths = split(tostring(customDimensions.deviationsDeclared), '|')
| mv-expand path = paths to typeof(string)
| summarize deviations = count(), projects = dcount(tostring(customDimensions.project)) by path
| order by deviations desc
| take 10
content.title: Most-deviated knowledge — candidates for a /custom/ override

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'AldcPhase'
| where '*' in ({Project}) or tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({Project})
| summarize phases = count(),
            notMounted = countif(tostring(customDimensions.bcqMounted) == 'false'),
            undeclared = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.undeclared))
          by ['project'] = tostring(customDimensions.project)
| extend ['BCQuality missing %'] = round(100.0 * notMounted / phases, 1)
| order by undeclared desc, ['BCQuality missing %'] desc
content.title: Per project — undeclared deviations and runs with BCQuality missing
